site.name: LuniBot
site.tagline: Self-hosted Discord bots. Free, open source, no accounts.

bots.name: Modmail
bots.tagline: Turn DMs into staff-managed support tickets.
bots.description: A Discord modmail bot. Members DM the bot and every conversation becomes a public thread in one tickets channel, where staff reply (optionally anonymously), claim, and close it. Closed tickets are archived as transcript files in a private channel and can be searched later.
features: Two-way DM to thread bridging, including edits and deletes
Claim and unclaim tickets, with a staff ping when a ticket goes back in the queue
Anonymous staff replies
Snippets (canned responses)
Transcripts archived as Discord attachments, searchable with /logs
SQLite storage, Docker support

commands.name: /reply <message> [anonymous]
commands.description: Reply to the user from inside a ticket

commands.name: /close [reason]
commands.description: Close the ticket and generate a transcript

commands.name: /logs user <target>
commands.description: Paginated ticket history for a user

requirements: Message Content and Server Members privileged intents
A tickets channel, a private archive channel, and a staff role

lunar.reason: Everything it does stays on your machine and in your Discord. It sends nothing to any other service, so the whole disc is lit.

shots.caption: A member’s DM arrives as a ticket thread
Staff reply from the thread, optionally anonymous
Closed ticket archived as a transcript

bots.name: DiscMeet
bots.tagline: Record voice meetings, get structured AI notes.
bots.description: A Discord meeting note-taker. It joins your voice channel, records each speaker separately, transcribes the audio with OpenAI Whisper, strips filler words, and posts a titled, structured summary with a timed transcript to an archive channel. Also includes a per-user expense tracker with monthly budgets.
features: Per-speaker voice recording with silence-based segmentation
Transcription via OpenAI Whisper
AI-generated title and structured meeting notes
Transcript and summary archived to a pinned log channel
Re-summarize the last session from cache
Expense tracking with categories and monthly budget

commands.name: /join
commands.description: Join your voice channel and start recording

commands.name: /summarize
commands.description: End the recording and generate AI notes

commands.name: /resummarize
commands.description: Re-run the summary on the last cached session

requirements: Discord bot token and client ID
OpenAI API key (usage billed by OpenAI)
bots.telemetry: Audio and transcripts are sent to OpenAI for transcription and summarisation. The bot itself sends nothing else.

lunar.reason: It records, writes and posts the notes from your machine, but the audio goes to OpenAI to be transcribed and summarised. One part of the work happens elsewhere.

shots.caption: Timed transcript, one line per speaker

bots.name: Music Bot
bots.tagline: Music from almost anywhere, with live synced lyrics.
bots.description: A Discord music bot. Type a song name or paste a link from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Twitch or any of 1800+ other sites, and control playback from buttons on a live now-playing card. Lyrics follow the song line by line, every member can save their own playlists, and audio is streamed straight from the source instead of being downloaded first.
features: Plays YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Twitch and 1800+ other sites
Spotify tracks, albums and playlists matched to a playable source, no API key needed
Searches try YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Audius, Mixcloud and the Internet Archive in turn, and a song one site refuses plays from the next
Button controls: pause, skip, previous, loop, shuffle, volume and audio filters
Live synced lyrics that highlight the current line, with a ±2s sync nudge
Search with autocomplete, a picker for ambiguous results, and an optional request channel
Personal saved playlists, a DJ role and 24/7 mode
Reconnects after voice drops and resumes where the song left off
SQLite storage, Docker support and a health check endpoint

commands.name: /play <query> [next] [choose] [lyrics]
commands.description: Play a song, playlist, album or live stream by name or link

commands.name: /lyrics [query] [live]
commands.description: Lyrics for the current song, a manual search, or live lyrics on the player

requirements: Python 3.10+ (the bot installs and updates yt-dlp itself)
Optional: Message Content privileged intent, for the music request channel
bots.telemetry: Audio is fetched from the sites you play, and searches go to YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Audius, Mixcloud and the Internet Archive. Lyrics come from LRCLIB, search suggestions from YouTube, and Spotify links from Spotify. yt-dlp updates come from PyPI. Musixmatch, Genius and the Spotify API are only contacted if you add their keys.

lunar.reason: It runs and controls playback on your machine, but the music, searches and lyrics all come from outside services. Most of what you hear is lit from elsewhere.

shots.caption: Live lyrics, current line in bold
Queue view with shuffle and clear

upcoming.name: Guard
upcoming.tagline: Stops nukes and raids, then puts the server back.
upcoming.description: A security bot you run yourself. It watches the audit log and stops anyone who mass-deletes channels or roles, mass-bans or grabs permissions, then rebuilds what they broke from its own backups. It also handles raids, verification, spam, scam links and impersonators, and can restore or copy a whole server from a backup. Every protection is free, with no limits on backups.
upcoming.note: Guard passes its tests but hasn't been tried against a live attack yet. It will be released once it has stopped a staged nuke on a test server.
features: Anti-nuke: limits per person and per action, then the attacker is quarantined and every change is undone
Panic mode: dangerous permissions removed from every role until the server is safe
Automatic backups of roles, channels, permissions, emojis, settings, bans and member roles, with no cap
Restore: repair what is missing, match a backup exactly, or load it into a new server
New bots get no permissions until approved; dangerous roles given to new accounts are taken back
Raid detection with lockdown, a join gate, and image-captcha verification
Heat-based spam filter, scam-link filter and impersonation check

commands.name: /setup [level]
commands.description: Log channel, quarantine role, protection level and a first backup

commands.name: /backup create|list|diff|restore|load
commands.description: Back up, compare and restore the server

commands.name: /panic on|off
commands.description: Strip dangerous permissions from every role

commands.name: /quarantine add|remove <member>
commands.description: Isolate a member and give their roles back later

commands.name: /verification setup <channel>
commands.description: Captcha or button verification for new members

requirements: Discord bot token with the Server Members and Message Content intents
The Administrator permission, with Guard's role at the top of the list
upcoming.telemetry: It downloads a public list of phishing domains from GitHub every 6 hours and looks up invite codes posted in your server. Backups and messages stay on your machine.

lunar.reason: Not released yet. The disc is there but not lit: Guard is built and in testing, and its first release will light it.
